reproducibility_gaps: No repository license is present at the pinned snapshot.
No dependency/environment manifest or package-version specification is present.
No installation procedure or hardware provenance is documented.
The Burgers workflow loads external burgers_shock.mat, which is not bundled and is only linked to an external PINNs repository.
Gate-network pretraining in BB.py and BB4.py hard-codes CUDA tensor placement with .cuda(), despite exposing a configurable --device argument.
Canonical trained checkpoints and expected result artifacts are not present in the four-file pinned tree.
notes: R2 reflects complete source availability with explicit PDE/model selectors, seeds, architectures, training hyperparameters and evaluation logic, but no reconstructable environment/install surface and incomplete data/runtime provenance.
